prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate exactly ONE high-fidelity, legible Simplified Chinese DooKnow desktop UI design, approximately 1536×1024, no browser/device frame, no presentation captions. Image 1 is the matching REAL pre-redesign baseline: its content, visible actions, user role and selected state are authoritative. Image 2 PILOT-WS-001 is STYLE ONLY: use its restrained blue #4566c6, white #ffffff, light-gray #f7f8fa, text #272b3a, muted #657084, fine #e6e9f1 dividers, 8px radii, clear typographic density and aligned flat surfaces. Do not transfer its owner rail, notebook tree, empty-note state, or unrelated actions.
ROLE BOUNDARY: this is a standalone authorization/public share page. NO owner avatar/rail/sidebar/private note tree/settings/apps/recent/favorites/trash navigation. NO blog navigation unless explicitly present. Preserve only this baseline's role-specific brand/header/footer and content. No ToDoo brand/task/calendar content, teams/members, AI chat, social login, password gate, upload/publish controls, fabricated counts/success/connected state. No API/contract/developer metadata or requestId/version/hash/cursor/nonce/CSRF fields in UI. One coherent state only, no simultaneous overlays or all-state dashboard. Preserve conditional controls and real enabled/disabled guards. Treat exact source templates as authority and make existing primary actions reachable; do not shrink legibility.
SELECTED PAGE:
PUBLIC LARGE-FILE FRAGMENT READER. Image 1 is the ordinary reader host/content reference ONLY; the selected large-fragment state is SOURCE-DERIVED from ShareReader.vue, not a claim it was captured in that baseline. Preserve guest header blue book DooKnow | 分享笔记, far-right eye badge 只读; no edit action. Article title 让知识保持可用. Under title retain the actual source large-file reason 大文件或长行文档暂不支持公开编辑，请由所有者编辑, then muted 更新于 2026/11/5 00:50:00. Render only the current fragment body with the known isolated fixture text: 用于公开页面界面盘点的隔离示例，不包含真实用户资料。; h2 记录与回顾; paragraph 把观察留下，给下一步提供线索。 Below current fragment a quiet action area exact status 正在阅读当前片段 and outlined enabled button 下一片段. Source state selected: large=true, current HTML rendered, nextCursor exists, loading=false, no fragment error. Do NOT add loading or failed banners at same time. Fragment rendering returns empty headings array, so NO desktop/mobile TOC at all even if current fragment has a heading; use centered single-column article. The next action REPLACES current fragment and scrolls to top, not append/infinite scroll; do not draw page number, arbitrary-jump input, previous-fragment button, progress %, fragment count or cursor metadata. No editor, mode switch, source/download/owner controls or full-note save. Footer exact 由 DooKnow 分享　｜　内容随原笔记保存同步更新. Clean natural whitespace to bottom. This one large-file read state only.
